question_record.context: During a recent incident, emails with a malicious URL `dj01161621.bravesand-e1ccd718.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io` were sent from `raphaelt@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` to `alyssat@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co`. The URL was subsequently clicked on a device, triggering a related alert.
question_record.question: In the latest proxy logs, what IP address is shown connecting to `login.micro.demo.antoinetest.ovh`?
solution: The email account with SID `S-1-5-21-1840151686-3534835288-156286563-1127` received an email with a malicious URL which was later removed.
A malicious URL was clicked on the host `vnevado-win11h`.
A connection from IP address `231.60.52.209` to login.micro.demo.antoinetest.ovh was observed in proxy logs, associated with the host `vnevado-win11h`.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Mail_Recipient' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
